title: K-flat cone counit equality for fixed data
statement: Let f:Z→Y be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes with the recorded derived pullback F [def-pc-derived-pullback], supplied strong monoidal structure [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and canonical shift-unit comparisons c [def-sc-scheme-canonical-shift-unit-iso]. Write H for the additive termwise tensor pullback on homotopy categories, and Qh for derived localization. Fix e:F(O_Y[1])≅O_Z[1] and epsilon:Qh_Y⋙F→H⋙Qh_Z. Assume at every homotopy object X that epsilon(X[1]) followed by the shift comparison of H⋙Qh_Z equals F of the Qh_Y shift comparison followed by a(Qh_Y X) and epsilon(X)[1], where a(K)=F(c_Y(K) inverse), the supplied inverse tensorator, e tensor identity, c_Z(FK). For every map p:P→Q of K-flat complexes, put C=mappingCone.triangleh(p), T=Qh_Y.mapTriangle(C) and W=(H⋙Qh_Z).mapTriangle(C). Then epsilon(C.obj3)≫W.mor3 = F(T.mor3)≫a(T.obj1)≫epsilon(C.obj1)[1]. The added hypothesis is a shift square independent of cones, not the cone equality itself.

proof.text: Apply naturality of epsilon to the third arrow of the homotopy mapping-cone triangle. Postcompose with the shift comparison of H⋙Qh_Z, then use the assumed shift square at the first object. Expand Qh.mapTriangle and use functoriality of composition and associativity. This is a purely categorical implication; no existence of compatible data is asserted.

statement_change.old_statement: For fixed shifted-unit isomorphism and counit data, the normalized connecting-map equality holds for every morphism of K-flat complexes.
statement_change.what: The original unrestricted e and epsilon need not obey a shift square. On identity pullback over Spec Q, negating e negates the right side but leaves the nonzero cone projection for P the unit and Q=0 unchanged. Add the missing shift-compatibility condition and prove the resulting categorical implication.
